name: Handbook QA
description: Questions about examples/data/employee-handbook.md with reference answers, expected sections and key facts. Includes one question the handbook cannot answer.

inputs.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?

cases.reference: Full-time employees get 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, plus public holidays.

inputs.question: Can I carry unused vacation days into next year, and when do they expire?

cases.reference: Up to five unused days can be carried over; carried-over days expire on 31 March.

inputs.question: What is the hotel limit per night for business trips?

cases.reference: Hotels are reimbursed up to 180 EUR per night in major cities and 120 EUR elsewhere.

inputs.question: When do I need a doctor's note for being sick?

cases.reference: A doctor's note is required for absences longer than three consecutive working days.

inputs.question: Who do I report a phishing email to, and how quickly?

cases.reference: Report suspected phishing emails to security@northwind.example within one hour.

inputs.question: How much can I spend on home-office equipment?

cases.reference: Up to 500 EUR every two years for home-office equipment.

inputs.question: Until when can a customer get a full refund?

cases.reference: Within 30 days of purchase if the product is unused; between 30 and 90 days a store credit is offered instead.

inputs.question: Am I allowed to bring my dog to the office?

cases.reference: The handbook does not say; the assistant should say it does not know.
